title: 'system' block header rules keep their old width after a resize (overflow the margin when narrower, stop short when wider)
observed: kiln defect (render). In s1c at 120 cols, 'system ■ Interrupted…' blocks had a header rule ending 2 columns before the edge like every other block. After RESIZE 80 24 and 60 24, the system rules ran to the last column (no right margin) while you/kiln rules kept the margin; after RESIZE 160 40 the system rules stopped at ~col 118 while other rules reached col 158.
expected: System blocks re-wrap on resize like every other block, with the same right margin.
